stage: H03 new synthetic DEV task-headroom preflight only; original WSP101 worlds forbidden
design_basis: Prospective algebra-only audit of ALL candidate program signatures BEFORE creating/reading any H03 simulated worlds; not a scientific first-use.
hypothesis: A fixed set of 22 source interventions covering six non-equivalent 7-bit causal-law families and 546 programs will fully identify heldout causal queries in all worlds without saturating a finite Bayes control under noisy observations.
masks: 7-bit nonzero only, popcount(mask) in [2,4], independent 6-family grammar = 546 candidate programs
development_world_ids: 16 independently labeled H03 DEV worlds 0..15; generated via SHA256 H03 domain separation, never H02 or accepted WSP101 worlds
source_action_selection: Greedy maximum-separating pair coverage on the full grammar response matrix (not observed H03 worlds): source pool excludes 24 preregistered HELDOUT actions, smallest remaining action breaks ties. Source size 22; source signatures for 449 equivalence classes identify all distinct heldout-response classes; 0 source aliases differ on heldout output.
public_dynamics: Each fresh reset returns 0, first intervention action reports 0 and latches a hidden causal effect, following action 0 reveals effect XOR independent observation noise. Passive-only action0/action0 always 0. Reward equals observation; source receives no mask/family ID.
noise: 1/8 SHA256 domain-separated per (H03 world ID, source action, episode ordinal), no noise in 24 heldout evaluator-only causal outcomes
budgets: 16 DEV worlds x 22 source probes x 2 actions=704 active steps, 16 x 24=384 heldout questions; 546-hypothesis exact Bayesian control with correct p=1/8
controls: Full 546-program uniform-prior Bayes symbolic model, independent of world generator, identical observed actions/outcomes and correct likelihood
Exact lookup on observed interventions (must abstain on 24 disjoint heldouts)
Source-identifiability exhaustive 546-program auditor uses noiseless evaluator source only for scoring, never supplies oracle labels to learners
Determinism, negative tampering, action budget, passive-no-information, cold replay controls

frozen_classification.DEV_NONCEILING_HEADROOM: All 16 worlds heldout-query-identifiable; 0.62<=strong Bayes accuracy<=0.90; >=0.10 gain over best of passive-prior or fixed-zero controls; positive likelihood and no original data use
frozen_classification.DEV_CONTROLS_WEAK_OR_NO_SEPARATION: All identifiable but Bayes accuracy<0.62 or advantage over best static prior<0.10
frozen_classification.DEV_SOURCE_UNDERIDENTIFIED: Any noiseless source fingerprint has a competing program with a differing heldout response (absolute veto before accuracy)
frozen_classification.DEV_INVALID: Unexpected source leakage, unauthorized world ID/first use, code changes after freeze affecting task, malformed public data or disagreement between independent solver and simulator public interfaces

scientific_prohibition: Only artificial DEV task headroom, no direct weight learning, no fully trained recurrent baseline, no AGI pass or model promotion. Exact Bayes is optimal under its true grammar/noise/prior assumptions; do not promise higher expected accuracy than Bayes.
post_result: Preserve outcomes and identifiers, no retuning or resampling H03 after results, if capacity/headroom fails stop and separately design a new task.
operation: WSP101 isolated research branch, existing push CI, no merge/deploy/loop/controller/paid APIs/third-party donor or scheduler
